description: The port's Files.writeTextAtomic (design D4): writes <path>.tmp-<suffix>, fsyncs it, renames it over the target in one step (Os.rename) and fsyncs the folder; creates the folders above the target. suffix is tempSuffix() of web/src/platform/atomicWrite.ts; the plugin makes one when it is left out. The path is relative to the app's data folder.

errors.description: A path the port does not accept.
